guides.title: Session plan: what order to do things
guides.body:
A clean solo run. Each line has its own step-by-step guide.

1. **Round 1**: go Beast at the purple flame shrine in spawn. Smash the crate on the truck for the **Summoning Key**. Shock the crane meter at the Easy Street entrance for the **pen**.
2. **Rounds 2 to 4**: open one district at a time. In each one, grab the shield part, Beast the ritual item, and Beast-shock the perk panels you want.
3. **Do the four rituals** as you get each item. A Margwa comes after the 2nd and the 4th ritual: its heart is an Apothicon Servant part.
4. **Go down to the Rift** with the four Gateworms and do the Sacred Place ritual. Pack-a-Punch opens.
5. **Sword**: note the three tram symbols, open the wall in the Rift, charge your egg at all four statues.
6. Build the **Apothicon Servant** once you have the heart, a tentacle (top Harvest Pod) and Xenomatter (round 12+).
7. Optional: Civil Protector fuses, sword upgrade, Li'l Arnie upgrade.

| District | Ritual item | Ritual site |
|---|---|---|
| Junction / Easy Street | Lawyer's pen | Nero's apartment above Easy Street |
| Waterfront | Championship belt | The Anvil boxing gym |
| Canal | Detective badge | Ruby Rabbit nightclub |
| Footlight | Toupee | Black Lace Burlesque |

Perk hint: in the Junction, in front of the doors to the three districts, a broken bottle shows where three perks spawned this game. Red is Juggernog, green is Speed Cola, yellow is Double Tap.

guides.title: Power the perks with the Beast
guides.intro: Shadows of Evil has no main power switch. You switch on each perk yourself with a Beast shock.

steps.title: Become the Beast
steps.text: Hold use at a shrine with a purple flame. Solo you get three Beast uses and refill one per round. Each lasts about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Shock the perk panel
steps.text: Charge and fire the Beast shock at the small electric panel beside the machine. The machine lights up and can be bought as a human.

steps.title: Find Juggernog, Speed Cola and Double Tap
steps.text: They move between districts each game. Look at the broken bottle in front of each district door: red = Juggernog, green = Speed Cola, yellow = Double Tap.

guides.title: Summoning Key, rituals and Pack-a-Punch
guides.intro: Everything here needs the Beast. Each ritual item sits in a crate you can only reach or break as the Beast.

steps.title: Get the Summoning Key
steps.text: Go Beast. Melee the crate in the back of the truck. Turn back to human and pick up the key.

steps.title: Ritual item 1: Lawyer's pen
steps.where: Just outside the Easy Street entrance
steps.text: As the Beast, shock the meter by the crane. The crane swings in and drops its crate, which breaks. Pick up the pen as a human. Every ritual item you pick up spawns two Keepers.

steps.title: Ritual item 2: Championship belt
steps.text: A crate hangs from a chain above the district. As the Beast, grapple to the platform where it hangs and melee it so it falls. Pick up the belt.

steps.title: Ritual item 3: Detective badge
steps.text: The crate is behind a locked grate in the canals. As the Beast, find the brickwork painted with the Beast mark and shock the hidden meter behind it. The grate opens. Melee the crate and take the badge.

steps.title: Ritual item 4: Toupee
steps.text: The crate sits on the edge of a building across a gap. As the Beast, cross the gap and knock the crate down. It breaks on the ground. Take the toupee.

steps.title: Do a ritual
steps.text: Place the item on its altar, then use the altar with the Summoning Key. Survive the Keepers and zombies until the floating person dies. A Gateworm appears above the altar: take it. A Margwa spawns after your 2nd and your 4th ritual.
options: Pen: Nero's apartment above Easy Street
Belt: The Anvil gym, Waterfront
Badge: Ruby Rabbit nightclub, Canal
Toupee: Black Lace Burlesque, Footlight

steps.title: Place the first two Gateworms
steps.where: The Rift (subway under the Junction), Sacred Place
steps.text: With all four rituals done, the Sacred Place opens. Put a Gateworm on each of the two fiery stands on the altar side. Walls rise out of the gap.

steps.title: Cross and place the other two
steps.text: Wall-run across the gap on the new walls. Place the last two Gateworms on the far stands. A one-way path back to the altar appears.

steps.title: Final ritual
steps.text: Start the ritual at the altar and survive the Keepers. The Shadowman thanks you and a Margwa spawns. The sky turns red and the Pack-a-Punch portal opens in the Sacred Place. Packing is slow on this map.

steps.title: Part 1: Eagle Plate
steps.text: The wiki lists two spots. If it is in neither, search the rest of the lounge.
options: Leaning against the window in the Smoke Lounge
Against the wall opposite that window

steps.title: Part 2: Fuel Canisters
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: Leaning on the window across from the perk machine
On the bridge that leads to the lounge
Inside the lounge, left of the paid gate to the Waterfront train station, leaning on an overturned coffee table

steps.title: Part 3: Screen
steps.text: The wiki lists two spots.
options: Next to the perk machine
In the tunnel to the tram station, on a bench on the left

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Hold use at a workbench. The shield boosts you forward and knocks zombies away. White gas canisters with a red valve refill one charge; Max Ammo refills all.

steps.title: Fuse 1
steps.text: Open the 1250 door near the district's train station and perk machine. The fuse is on the walkway behind it.

steps.title: Fuse 2
steps.text: Same idea: 1250 door near the train station, fuse on the walkway.

steps.title: Fuse 3
steps.text: Same idea: 1250 door near the train station, fuse on the walkway.

steps.title: Fit the fuses
steps.text: Put all three fuses in the fuse box called the Master Switch.

steps.title: Call the robot
steps.text: Costs 2000. You can pay part now and the rest later. Only one robot at a time, and only when the panel is green. It fights in that district and can revive you, but its kills give no points.
options: Junction, near the GobbleGum machine and Chang's laundry
Canal, in front of the Ruby Rabbit, over the bridge near the hotel
Footlight, near the Apothicon statue by the gate to the Burlesque
Waterfront, near the Mystery Box spawn

steps.title: Part 1: Margwa Heart
steps.text: Margwas drop it. If you miss it, the next Margwa drops a new one. Margwas come after rituals 2 and 4.

steps.title: Part 2: Margwa Tentacle
steps.text: Comes from a top-tier (fully grown) Harvest Pod. Open fully grown pods until it drops.

steps.title: Part 3: Xenomatter
steps.text: Dropped by Parasites or Insanity Elementals once round 12 is reached.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Only one player can take the built one. After that it also goes into the Mystery Box. It cannot be Pack-a-Punched on this map.

steps.title: Note the three tram symbols
steps.text: Each ride shows a symbol in a red-lit window. They change every game. Fastest: ride Waterfront to Footlight looking out the side **opposite** the Bootlegger wall gun (two symbols), then Footlight to Canal looking out the **Bootlegger** side (the third, just before Canal station).
options: Leaving Waterfront: right side, top right window of a square building after the small shack
Leaving Footlight: left side, after the Peep Show and Celeste's signs
Leaving Canal: left side, after the Devil-O-Donuts and Hotel signs

steps.title: Open the sword wall
steps.where: The Rift, next to the box spawn and GobbleGum machine
steps.text: Go Beast. Nine symbols show around a doorway opposite the Sacred Place. Shock the three you saw. A wrong set hides the symbols until next round. The wall dissolves to show a statue with swords and eggs.

steps.title: Take an egg
steps.text: Use the statue to take one egg.

steps.title: Charge the egg at four statues
steps.text: Place the egg on each Apothicon statue and kill zombies near it. It takes 12 souls, then glows white. Pick it up and go to the next.
options: Footlight alley, under the perk machine spot
Canal, behind the Ruby Rabbit front stairs
Waterfront, in the destroyed building, room after the perk machine
The Rift, opposite the sword statue

steps.title: Claim the sword
steps.text: After four statues the egg glows blue. Return it to the statue to get your sword.

steps.title: Get the Arch-Ovum
steps.text: Talk to the Keeper spirit floating above your own character's altar. It gives you the Arch-Ovum egg.
options: Nero: apartment above Easy Street
Floyd: Anvil gym
Jack: Ruby Rabbit
Jessica: Burlesque

steps.title: Four red circles: kill the Margwas
steps.text: Place the egg on a circle. Solo, up to two Margwas spawn and hunt only you. Kill them; the egg comes back with less shell. **One circle per round.**
options: Footlight: in front of the Burlesque entrance
Canal: between the workbench and the Ruby Rabbit entrance
Waterfront: right in front of the Anvil gym
Junction: outside the Easy Street entrance

steps.title: Hand over the sword
steps.text: Give your sword to the Keeper spirit. It comes back upgraded.

steps.title: Get 100 kills with Li'l Arnie
steps.text: The player holding Arnie needs the kills.

steps.title: Throw Arnie at the three costume items
options: Top hat: on a mannequin's head in Nero's apartment
Bow tie: on a shelf in the boxing gym
Walking cane: on a sofa, first floor of the Ruby Rabbit

steps.title: Throw Arnie at the stage
steps.text: Throw it at the ritual stand on the stage. A little creature dances with four Gateworms. When the song ends, your Arnies are upgraded.

guides.title: Session plan: what order to do things
guides.body:
1. **Rounds 1 to 3**: open toward the Animal Testing Lab or the Garage. Both lead to the Courtyard.
2. **Power**: drop into the Courtyard next to the bridge and pull the switch on the generator. The bridge comes down.
3. **Link all three teleporters**. The Pack-a-Punch door in spawn opens a bit with each one.
4. Hit the box for the Wunderwaffe DG-2 and Monkey Bombs.
5. With Monkey Bombs: the secret perk.

| Teleporter | Where | Door |
|---|---|---|
| A | Behind the Animal Testing Lab | 1250 |
| B | Up the stairs from the Garage | stairs from the Garage |
| C | Behind the Courtyard | 1250 |

steps.title: Turn on the power
steps.where: Courtyard, back of the big generator
steps.text: Reach the Courtyard by dropping down next to the bridge from the Lab or Garage side. Pull the switch on the generator.

steps.title: Link Teleporter A
steps.where: Behind the Animal Testing Lab (1250 door)
steps.text: Activate the teleporter at its pad, then run straight back to the mainframe in the spawn room and use it before time runs out.

steps.title: Link Teleporter B
steps.where: Up the stairs from the Garage
steps.text: Same thing: activate, then run back to the mainframe.

steps.title: Link Teleporter C
steps.text: Same thing again.

steps.title: Pack-a-Punch
steps.text: With all three linked, the door in spawn is fully open. 5000 points to pack, 2500 to add an ammo upgrade.

guides.title: Secret perk: the robot eye beam

steps.title: Get Monkey Bombs and link all teleporters
Teleport with a monkey, three times
steps.text: Throw a Monkey Bomb on the teleporter pad and teleport together with it. Back at the mainframe, one of three lights on the panel by the mainframe turns from red to green. Do this at A, B and C.

steps.title: Press the red button
steps.text: The giant robot head outside fires its eye beam. It bounces off the metal welcome sign and melts a snow pile, revealing Stamin-Up or Deadshot Daiquiri.

guides.title: Session plan: what order to do things
guides.body:
1. **Round 1**: a free fuse is waiting in spawn for the gondola. Open up toward the Armory and **turn on the power**.
2. **Rounds 2 to 5**: activate landing pads as you pass them. Grab shield parts in both courtyards. Kill zombies near each dragon head to feed it 8.
3. **Undercroft** (opens with power): turn on anti-gravity for the shield Screen. Feed the third dragon. Visit a Pack-a-Punch spot.
4. Visit the other Pack-a-Punch spots (Bastion and Rocket Platform). After two, the third builds the machine.
5. Take the **bow** from the knight's room above the Undercroft.
6. **Round 8 or so**: the first Panzersoldat drops a Ragnarok part. Get the other two at the rocket test and from the Death Ray.
7. Pick **one bow upgrade** and follow its guide. Storm and Wolf are the most forgiving solo.

Anti-gravity: stand about 4 seconds on each of the four floor tiles around the Pyramid until they stay blue. It then turns on and comes back every 2 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Turn on the power
steps.text: The switch is next to a row of generators. Power opens the Undercroft.

steps.title: Spot 1: Undercroft
steps.where: Next to the big central pillar, the side away from the dragon statue
steps.text: Walk up to the machine pieces and accept the prompt to teleport them.

steps.title: Spot 2: Bastion
steps.where: Outdoors behind the power switch, opposite the Wundersphere
steps.text: Teleport the pieces here too. After two spots, the third builds the machine.

steps.title: Spot 3: Rocket Platform
steps.text: Reach it with the Undercroft teleporter, or the Bastion Wundersphere once its landing pad is on.

steps.title: Find the machine later
steps.text: The machine moves between the three spots from time to time. A board near each spot names where it is now.

steps.title: Turn on each landing pad
steps.text: Stand by the landing pad and use it. A blue glow means it is on. Then its Wundersphere launches you there for 500 points.
options: Rocket Test Area sphere lands in the Spawn Room
Death Ray Area sphere lands at the Rocket Test Area
Balcony by the Gate Trap sphere lands at the computer by the Clock Tower
Courtyard by the computer room sphere lands on the staircase by the dragon

steps.title: Part 1: Eagle Plate
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: On the ground against big crates by a window, right of the ground-floor entrance to Mission Control
Clock Tower ground floor, on the floor just left of a corpse sitting at a desk
Left side of the stairs up to the Clock Tower and its landing pad, leaning on wooden barrels

steps.title: Part 2: Fuel Canisters
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: Coming uphill from Double Tap: on crates right away on your right, by a window
Same entrance, turn left up the small stairs: at the bottom right of the other small stairs that lead only to a window, against small crates
From the second-floor landing pad, take the stairs up toward the Death Ray: at the base of the second flight, on the left against the stone wall

steps.title: Part 3: Screen
steps.text: All three need anti-gravity on (stand on the four tiles around the Pyramid). Double jump to reach them.
options: Above the Pack-a-Punch teleporter platform, hanging on the wall (double jump and wall-run)
Above the doorway to the Rocket Test teleporter, just under the glowing eye glyph
From the workbench by the Pyramid, turn to face the Pyramid and look up left: hanging on the metal rings that join the four Keeper statues

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Free replacement at the same bench if it breaks.

guides.title: Feed the dragons and get the bow

steps.title: Dragon 1
steps.where: Courtyard by Double Tap, above the tunnel to the underground lab
steps.text: Kill a zombie near the stone head to wake it. Then keep killing zombies close to it. It lifts and eats one body at a time; kills during a meal do not count. 8 bodies and it crumbles.

steps.title: Dragon 2
steps.where: Mission Control, Speed Cola room, above the fireplace at the back
steps.text: Feed it 8.

steps.title: Dragon 3
steps.where: Undercroft Pyramid room, across from the workbench
steps.text: Feed it 8.

steps.title: Take the bow
steps.where: The room right above the Undercroft, where a knight lies
steps.text: The bow floats above the crate at the back. Every player can take one. If you bleed out, take it again here.

steps.title: Part 1: kill the first Panzersoldat
steps.text: It drops a part. If you miss it, the next Panzersoldat drops it again.

steps.title: Part 2: rocket test console
steps.text: When a rocket test is about to start, pull the lever with a red light at the bottom of the left stairs behind the rocket (the stairs closest to the Wundersphere). Run into the teleporter tunnel. Survive until all three console lights right of the teleporter are solid green, then use the console quickly. The part appears in the teleporter. Miss the window and you wait for the next test.

steps.title: Part 3: Death Ray part, mid-air
steps.text: Turn on the Death Ray once (1000 points). A part then floats above the Bastion. Ride the Wundersphere from the Upper Courtyard or the Lower Courtyard second floor and press use as you fly past it.
options: On top of the orb above the door to the power switch room
Floating in the air behind the Wundersphere

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Plant it to trap zombies and Panzers, or slam it to kill everything nearby.

steps.title: Shoot the weathervane
steps.text: A small tower has a lightning symbol and a weathervane on top. Shoot the vane with the bow. The bricks fall and drop the broken arrow. Pick it up.

steps.title: Light three bonfires
steps.text: Shoot each with the bow until it burns.
options: Exit the Clock Tower, look over the edge right of the computer: on top of a castle turret (also shootable from the Mule Kick room below)
From the KRM-262 wall buy by Double Tap, turn about 45 degrees right: far right edge of the ridge over the rocket test site
Rocket Platform, leaving the teleporter tunnel: high on the cliff to your right, looking back at the castle

steps.title: Wall-run the five wind symbols
steps.text: Five long hexagon carvings of a gust of wind are on the walls. Touch all five in one wall-run without touching the ground. A sound tells you if you failed; wait for the next anti-gravity if needed.

steps.title: Fill three urns and re-shoot the bonfires
steps.text: Kill 5 zombies near an urn. Then draw the bow next to it: the arrow sparks. Shoot a bonfire with it; lightning then circles the flames. Do all three bonfires. Missed? Go back to the urn.
options: Room above Double Tap, between the workbench and the L-CAR 9 wall buy
Rocket Platform tunnel, on the wall across from the teleporter
Clock Tower ground floor, on crates under the spiral stairs

steps.title: Reforge the arrow
steps.text: Blue fog is now on the ground where the arrow fell. Use it to place the arrow. Wait a few seconds and take the reforged arrow.

steps.title: Charge and claim
steps.where: Undercroft, lightning shrine next to the Pyramid
steps.text: Place the arrow in the shrine. Kill 20 zombies inside the square formed by the stairs around the Pyramid. When it stops taking souls, place your bow. Take the Storm Bow.

steps.title: Shoot the red symbol
steps.where: Clock Tower, top of the spiral staircase
steps.text: Shoot the glowing red symbol on the wall. The clock opens and drops the broken arrow pieces. Pick them up.

steps.title: Shoot the hot rock after a rocket test
steps.text: Tests happen every 5 to 7 minutes. Wait near the blast doors. Right after a test, walk straight out, stop just past the cross tracks, turn 90 degrees right and shoot the orange glowing rock on top of the small VMP building. A fireball flies to the castle.

steps.title: Light three rings from a Wundersphere
steps.text: Hold a charged shot as you launch and hit the ring while still in the air. A distant wail means it worked.
options: Spawn, between the KRM-262 wall buy and Double Tap (fly from the Bastion or Rocket Platform)
Bastion, between the Death Ray and its Wundersphere (fly from the Upper Courtyard by the Kuda)
Outside the Clock Tower on the way to the Bastion (fly from the Lower Courtyard above Double Tap)

steps.title: Kill zombies while standing in each ring
steps.text: Stand inside so the screen edges glow orange. The zombies do not need to be inside. When full, a fire pillar shoots up to the big fireball over the Bastion.

steps.title: Read the fireplace symbol
steps.where: Clock Tower clockwork, top of the stairs
steps.text: Use the exposed clockwork. A symbol lights up. It names one fireplace, and only that fireplace's ring stays lit.
options: Arrowhead with two pierced triangles, dot left and right: Mission Control fireplace under the dragon (ring at the Bastion)
Cross with a dot left and right: Samantha's room (ring at spawn)
Arrowhead with pierced triangles above and below it: Lower Courtyard supply room across from the dragon (ring outside the Clock Tower)

steps.title: Hop the lava to the fireplace
steps.where: From that ring to its fireplace
steps.text: Stand in the ring and shoot the ground far toward the fireplace: a lava mound appears. Stand next to it (screen glows orange) and shoot again. Hit the fireplace in 4 shots or fewer, then use it to put the arrow in the fire. Failed? Try again next round.

steps.title: Catch the reforged arrow
steps.text: The big fireball is now low. Hold use under it. It hardens, explodes and drops the arrow. If the prompt is stubborn, stand against the Death Ray and inch toward it.

steps.title: Charge and claim
steps.where: Undercroft, box with dark volcanic rocks by the Pyramid
steps.text: Place the arrow, kill 20 zombies close to the box, use the box, take the Fire Bow.

steps.title: Shoot the Demon Gate glyph
steps.where: Gate Trap room next to Double Tap
steps.text: The glyph is painted on the sloped ceiling between the trap's two iron gates. Shoot it with the bow and take the broken arrow.

steps.title: Free the urn
steps.text: A floor tile glows purple. Kill a zombie with a **melee** hit right on it. The tile breaks. Use the urn: it rises and makes a summoning circle.

steps.title: Return six Keeper skulls
steps.text: Use each skull; it glows purple and flies back to the circle.
options: Past the L-CAR 9 wall buy going up from spawn, before the Mule Kick round room: on the floor nook left of a slumped corpse, under a lantern
Upper Courtyard, on a windowsill up the stairs past the Vesper wall buy, before Mission Control
Samantha's room, in the open toy chest by the left wall near the bed
Double Tap, just right of the tipped-over shelves on the broken wall
Undercroft teleporter room, in the sink by a bucket, right side as you enter
Rocket Platform, in the back of the truck left of the Trip Mine wall buy

steps.title: Feed six crawlers
steps.text: Lead six legless zombies into the circle. A skull kills each one. Grenades or the Crawl Space GobbleGum make crawlers.

steps.title: Learn the three crests
steps.where: Trophy Room, then the armour hallway
steps.text: The demon says three of six crests in an order. Write the order down. Shoot the urn to hear it again. In the T-shaped hallway between Samantha's room, the Armory and Mission Control, use each suit of armour to see which glyph goes with each crest (it changes every game). Ignore the suit with no crest.

steps.title: Collect the glyphs
steps.text: Your kills now sometimes drop glyphs. Keep going until you have the three you need. Extra ones do no harm.

steps.title: Shoot the name
steps.text: Shoot the three correct glyphs on the circle floor, in the order the demon said them. A fire pillar rises. Place the arrow in it and take it back reforged. Wrong order resets the name.

steps.title: Charge and claim
steps.where: Undercroft, box with the Demon Gate glyph by the Pyramid
steps.text: Place the arrow and kill zombies near the box. Then place the bow and kill 20 more. Use the glyph to take the Void Bow.

steps.title: Use the four paintings in order
steps.where: The paintings swap places each game
steps.text: Find the painting for each scene and use them in this order: 1. the king on his throne with wolves; 2. the king in his helmet on a horse; 3. a castle on a mountain with lightning; 4. the king slumped by his shield with a servant. A guitar strum and a wolf symbol mean it was right.
options: Trophy Room, near the KRM-262 wall buy
Clock Tower, just before the spiral stairs
Next to the barrier between Samantha's room and the Armory
Control Room balcony closest to the Armory

steps.title: Take the broken arrow
steps.where: Undercroft, bottom of the stairs from the Family Crypt
steps.text: Go down from Mission Control through the Family Crypt. The wolf symbol on the wall crumbles. Take the arrow.

steps.title: Shoot the red flag
steps.where: Rocket Platform, cliff above and left of the blast doors
steps.text: Shoot the base of the pole, not the cloth. Standing on the raised rocket platform helps. A glowing blue dog skull rolls down. Pick it up.

steps.title: Follow the spirit wolf to three dig spots
steps.where: Start at the Wolf box by the Pyramid
steps.text: Place the skull in the Wolf box. A ghost wolf walks off: stay close or it howls and you must restart it at the box. At each spot kill about 10 zombies, then pick up the bones (no prompt shows).

steps.title: Build the platform
steps.where: Undercroft, under a big hole high on the wall
steps.text: The wolf sits under the hole. With anti-gravity on, wall-run until a double wolf head symbol shows above the crack, then shoot it a few times until a platform forms.

steps.title: Open the coffin
steps.text: Use the coffin. The king's skeleton holds out the reforged arrow. Take it.

steps.title: Charge and claim
steps.where: Undercroft, Wolf box by the Pyramid
steps.text: Place the arrow. Kill 20 zombies on the stairs around the Pyramid or the floor it stands on. Place your bow, wait, take the Wolf Bow.

guides.title: Session plan: what order to do things
guides.body:
1. **Round 1**: grab a bucket, fill it at a pond and pour it into the Lab A or Lab B water switch. Collect seeds from zombies and plant them as you go.
2. **Rounds 2 to 4**: do the other lab switch. The Bunker door opens for free. Grab shield and gas mask parts on the way.
3. **Main power**: clear the web from turbine 3 underwater and survive the lockdown. Take the pump pipe from the grate.
4. Get the valve wheel (Mule Kick tunnel) and the pressure gauge (cocoons) for **Pack-a-Punch**.
5. **KT-4**: glowing scientist vial, spider venom from the Lab A cage, and the item at the end of the Mule Kick tunnel.
6. KT-4 the webs and kill the **Giant Spider**: free Widow's Wine and the fang.
7. Do your three trials, cleanse the four skulls for the **Skull of Nan Sapwe**, then go for the Masamune.

| Water | Where |
|---|---|
| Blue | Behind Lab A, before the route to the spider nest |
| Green | Behind Lab B, under scaffolding by a Divinium rock |
| Purple | Bunker Living Quarters, far left corner |
| Rainbow (iridescent) | Inside the sewer pipe ride (Masamune only) |

Inside Lab A (also the back room with the GobbleGum machine)

steps.text: Three lights above the switch are green and one flashes red. Dive into the water and slash the webs off turbine 3. The room locks.

steps.title: Survive the underwater lockdown
steps.text: Solo, 12 zombies spawn. They give no points. Surface or pop the spore at the back for air.

steps.title: Pull the main switch
steps.text: Perks now work. A pump pipe for Pack-a-Punch is on the grate in front of turbine 3. Take it.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Stops spore gas from blocking your sprint and guns, and lets you stay underwater longer. Breaks after about 10 gas clouds; take a new one at the bench.

steps.title: Ingredient 1: glowing vial
steps.text: Only after main power. A scientist zombie glows sickly yellow-green. Kill it; the vial on its hip drops and glows. Play rounds near Lab B and it shows up within a few rounds.

steps.title: Ingredient 2: spider venom
steps.text: With Lab A powered, lower the cage into the swamp. A purple mist arm inside attracts spiders. Lure one in, raise the cage, and a syringe takes its venom.

steps.title: Ingredient 3: the item at the end of the tunnel
steps.where: Flooded tunnel right of Mule Kick
steps.text: Swim to the very end of the Divinium tunnel, deeper than the valve wheel. Use the air pockets and shoot spores for air.

steps.title: Mix it
steps.text: Use the bench with all three. Take the KT-4. It now also appears in the Mystery Box. It shoots your plants to boost them, too.

steps.where: Spider lair behind the blue pond near Lab A

guides.title: Trials of the Ancients and the electric shield

steps.title: Start your trials
steps.text: Each player gets three random challenges. The altar shows them. Rewards: an empty perk bottle (top), a Dingo, SVG-100 or 205 Brecci (middle; drop it back in to reroll), and a Max Ammo (bottom).

steps.title: Electrify the shield
steps.text: Once every player has all three rewards, lightning strikes the altar now and then. Stand there holding the shield out until it is struck. The electric shield shocks zombies and halves perk and GobbleGum prices when you melee the machine.

steps.title: Take a bloody skull
steps.text: Four bloody skulls sit on the altar. Each has a symbol on its forehead. Take one.

steps.title: Cleanse it at the matching pedestal
steps.text: Put it on the pedestal with the same symbol. Defend it from green-glowing zombies until done, then bring it back. Symbols swap places each game.
options: In front of spawn, by the big central rock before the GobbleGum machine
By the Propeller Trap, near its lowest switch
Bunker docks, left of the main power switch, among wooden crates
Bunker operations room, downstairs by the KT-4 and Masamune benches

steps.title: Charge the Skull
steps.where: New stairs in front of the altar
steps.text: Go down where the fallen tree was. Try to take the Skull: the room locks and Keepers come for it. Solo, kill 20 Keepers. Then take it.

guides.title: Upgrade the KT-4 to the Masamune

steps.title: Electrify your shield
steps.text: See the trials guide.

steps.title: Ingredient 1: Liquid Divinium
steps.text: Melee the cage control panel with the electric shield. Step into the cage from inside Lab B: it drops into the swamp and opens. A skeleton below holds the vial. Take it and use the console to go back up.

steps.title: Ingredient 2: spider fang
steps.text: See the Giant Spider guide.

steps.title: Reveal the hidden planter
steps.where: Bunker Living Quarters, then the Mule Kick tunnel

steps.title: Get rainbow water
steps.where: Sewer pipe ride, Bunker to Lab B (500 each try)
steps.text: Start inside the Bunker operations room. Press use just after you pass the second blue section, as a lump of Divinium goes by on the right. Your bucket may need to be empty first.

steps.title: Grow the plant
steps.text: Plant a seed. Water it with rainbow water once a round for three rounds. Pick the special plant.

steps.title: Make the blue ammo
steps.where: Second bench, next to the KT-4 bench
steps.text: Hold the KT-4 in your hands and use the bench.

guides.title: Session plan: what order to do things
guides.body:
1. **Rounds 1 to 3**: open toward the Dragon Command Center. Pick up shield parts on the way.
2. **Power**, then press the button under Sophia's console. Zombies start dropping code cylinders.
3. **Rounds 4 to 8**: each cylinder calls a Groph Pod. Kill 15 zombies next to it to get a module. Buy Stamin-Up first if you can: pods get attacked fast.
4. Put the three modules in the Operations Bunker console, call the dragon, and **Pack-a-Punch** at the Hatchery.
5. Shoot the dragon egg down in the Hatchery and put it in a nest. Do the **Dragon Strike** lockdown when you have a packed gun.
6. Teach the egg (napalm, penetration, melee kills) and hatch it for the **Gauntlet**.
7. Optional: Tiamat's Maw, Draconite, Dragon Wings.

guides.title: Power, Sophia and the dragon ride

steps.title: Turn on the power
steps.where: Just past the entrance of the Dragon Command Center

steps.title: Talk to Sophia
steps.text: Press the button under her centre console. It flashes green, then back to red. Zombies now sometimes drop code cylinders.

steps.title: Use a code cylinder
steps.text: Each cylinder fits one console. A Groph Pod falls somewhere with a green beam above it.
options: Dragon Command Center
Supply Depot
Tank Factory

steps.title: Defend the pod
steps.text: Zombies attack it right away. Kill 15 zombies close to it (they get shocked when it counts). It opens: take the module. If the pod is destroyed, wait for another cylinder.

steps.title: Fit the modules
steps.where: Operations Bunker, middle of the room
steps.text: Put all three in the Dragon Network console.

steps.title: Ride the dragon
steps.where: Any of the three dragon platforms
steps.text: Call the dragon for 500 points and hold use to climb on. It drops you into the Hatchery. Pack-a-Punch is on the ground floor.

steps.title: Part 1: Dragon Visage
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: Top of the Operations Bunker stairs, look slightly left: on the floor between two small crates by a big broken bookshelf
On the right bunk of the two bunk beds touching the stairs up to Stamin-Up
Facing Stamin-Up, look left: on debris under the leftmost of three broken windows on the green wall

steps.title: Part 2: Core
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: On a wooden chair in the Juggernog room, by a desk lit by a lamp
On the door of the truck with blue barrels, downstairs from the store before the Bunker, opposite the GobbleGum machine
On a shelf in the Operations Bunker, right of the electric trap switch, before the stairs up to the Infirmary

steps.title: Part 3: Maw
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: Lowest level, beside the Wunderfizz, hanging on a big piece of wooden floor debris
Going upstairs, just past the doorway by the GobbleGum machine: on the wall next to the metal door to the Supply Depot
Top level, on the side of a crate straight ahead at the top of the stairs, same wall as the bridge switch

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Hold it in front of you to walk through dragon fire. Its melee shoots a green fireball (three charges, one back per round, all back on Max Ammo).

steps.title: Stand in dragon fire twice
steps.text: Be inside the area **before** the fire starts, shield held out, and stay in for the whole burn. Do it twice.

steps.title: Kill 50 zombies with the shield
steps.text: Melee or fireball. A sound plays when done.

steps.title: Shoot three purple symbols with fireballs
steps.text: A fresh shield from the bench refills your fireballs.
options: Dragon Command Center: stand on the left platform as if boarding the dragon, look left
Supply Depot: opposite the ramp up to Speed Cola, look up at the broken roof
Tank Factory: stand on the right platform as if boarding, look right, on the fallen robot's shoulder

steps.title: Dip the shield
steps.where: Dead dragon in Belinski Square, by the trial tombstones
steps.text: Hold use at the pool of blood. A few seconds later you have Tiamat's Maw (red fireballs, 35 hits).

steps.title: Start the lockdown
steps.where: Hatchery, crystal on the top floor
steps.text: Wait until you have a packed gun and ammo. Use the crystal. A Max Ammo floats near Pack-a-Punch; grab it before the last wave.

steps.title: Survive four waves
steps.text: Zombies, Manglers and Valkyrie Drones. No points. Pack-a-Punch is off during it.

steps.title: Take the Dragon Strike
steps.text: You also get 500 points.

steps.title: Upgrade: 40 kills
steps.text: Kill about 40 zombies with Dragon Strikes. A loud roar after a strike means done.

steps.title: Upgrade: mark the red flag
steps.text: Red Iron Cross flags stand outside the map. Solo, only one of the four stays. Find it and mark it with a strike.
options: Supply Depot: left dragon platform, look left
Dragon Command: left dragon platform, straight ahead at ground level, half hidden by rubble
Tank Factory: top of the stairs to Double Tap, look out near the hanging tank
Belinski Square: corner by Quick Revive, behind the gushing pipe

steps.title: Upgrade: second lockdown
steps.text: Start the lockdown again. In every wave, aim the strike outside as often as it recharges (about every 15 to 20 seconds). Then take the Draconite Controller from the crystal.

steps.title: Shoot down the egg
steps.where: Hatchery, above the sewer grate back to the square
steps.text: Shoot the only unbroken egg. It rolls to the right of the grate. Pick it up.

steps.title: Heat it in dragon fire
steps.where: Nest in front of Dragon Command, opposite the middle of the stairs
steps.text: Place it **before** the dragon breathes. Then wait out this round and one full round while it cools. Pick it up.

steps.title: Trial 1: napalm zombie kills
steps.text: Kill the burning zombies made by dragon fire. Holding the egg, trials go in order.

steps.title: Trial 2: penetration kills
steps.text: Multi-kills through bodies. The mounted MG42 on the Hatchery top floor (1000 points each time) counts. The GKZ-45 does not.

steps.title: Trial 3: melee kills
steps.text: Knife, Bowie or shield melee and fireballs count.

steps.title: Hatch it
steps.text: Place the egg. Survive the lockdown. Leave and come back when Sophia says it is ready.

steps.title: Claim the Gauntlet
steps.text: Use the fourth trial on the tombstone. The Gauntlet rises out of the ground.

guides.title: Session plan: what order to do things
guides.body:
1. **Rounds 1 to 3**: spawn Corruption Engine first. Open toward Origins and the jump pads.
2. Pick up shield and Keeper altar parts as you pass each area.
3. **Rounds 4 to 8**: activate the Mob of the Dead, Verrückt and Der Eisendrache engines.
4. Go to Nacht der Untoten upstairs and trap the giant Apothicon. **Pack-a-Punch** inside it.
5. Build the shield at the Nacht table. Hit the box for the Thundergun or Apothicon Servant.

steps.title: Pack-a-Punch it
steps.text: Now it upgrades for the normal price into the Estoom-oth.

guides.title: Session plan
guides.body:
1. **Rounds 1 to 3**: board windows and stay in the start room. Mule Kick is here.
2. Open the Help room for the Mystery Box, then the upstairs for the Wunderfizz.
3. Roll the box for the Thundergun or a Ray Gun.
4. Train in the start room or upstairs. There is nothing else to build.

guides.title: Session plan
guides.body:
1. You spawn in one of two start rooms, split by a locked door.
2. **Rounds 1 to 4**: open toward the power room on the far side.
3. **Power**: opposite the Mystery Box in that room. The door between start rooms opens.
4. Buy perks, then hit the box for the Wunderwaffe DG-2. Electric traps are on once power is on.

guides.title: Session plan
guides.body:
1. **Rounds 1 to 3**: get points in the start building.
2. Open the huts one by one: Storage Hut, Comm Room, Doctor's Quarters, Fishing Hut. Each one rolls a perk.
3. Follow the green beam to the box for the Wunderwaffe DG-2.
4. Electric traps cost 1000, the Flogger costs 750.

guides.title: Session plan
guides.body:
1. **Rounds 1 to 4**: open from the lobby through the dressing rooms toward the stage.
2. **Power** backstage. It opens the curtain and the lobby door, and crawlers can now spawn.
3. Link the teleporter and ride to Pack-a-Punch. You have 30 seconds up there.
4. Relink every time you want to go back.

steps.title: Turn on the power
steps.where: Backstage, by the wall gun spot (the M16 in the old game)
steps.text: It opens the stage curtain and the lobby door and starts the projector.

steps.title: Activate the teleporter
steps.text: Use the teleporter pad in the theater.

steps.title: Link it
steps.text: Go back to the lobby and use the mainframe.

steps.title: Teleport up
steps.text: Stand on it. It sends you to the projector room with Pack-a-Punch. After 30 seconds you are sent out, sometimes through a side room first, and land back at the mainframe.

steps.title: Relink for the next visit
steps.text: The teleporter cools down, then needs a new link each time.

guides.title: Session plan
guides.body:
1. **Rounds 1 to 3**: open up through the centrifuge floors.
2. **Power** on the top floor of the main building. The map turns to colour and space monkeys start.
3. Open each lander's door (1250 each) and ride B, D and F back to the centrifuge.
4. Press the rocket button right of the power switch. Pack-a-Punch opens at the launch pad.

steps.title: Turn on the power
steps.where: Top floor of the main building

steps.title: Ride each Lunar Lander from its pad
steps.text: Buy the ride at the pad itself (250). Calling a lander from the centrifuge does **not** count.
options: Lander B (Б): 1250 access door
Lander D (Д): 1250 access gate
Lander F (Ф): 1250 access door

steps.title: Launch the rocket
steps.where: Button right of the power switch

steps.title: Pack-a-Punch
steps.text: Once the rocket leaves, the big door opens. The machine is on the right. Stay as long as you like.

guides.title: Session plan
guides.body:
1. **Rounds 1 to 4**: open toward the underground waterfall area near the Bowie Knife.
2. Pull **both** power switches. Power turns on only after the second one.
3. Find the statue with a spinning part and stand on its slab. The Pack-a-Punch stairs rise.
4. Pack fast: after a while water washes you off the stairs.

steps.title: Pull switch 1
steps.where: Underground, near the Bowie Knife, where water falls on the turbines

steps.title: Pull switch 2
steps.text: Power and the water slide work after both.

steps.title: Find the spinning statue
steps.text: After power, parts of the statues spin. Solo, only one part spins. Not checked: which statue it is, so look at each.
options: Next to Quick Revive
Under the big wooden bridge
Next to the power switches
In the cave toward the old AK-74u wall buy

steps.title: Stand on its slab
steps.where: Stone slab next to that statue
steps.text: The part stops. The missing stairs to the machine rise out of the ground.

steps.title: Pack-a-Punch
steps.where: Top of the stairs in the start area
steps.text: A skull climbs the side of the stairs. When it reaches the top, water flushes you down.

guides.title: Session plan
guides.body:
1. **Area 51**: there are no rounds. Zombies get stronger over time. Buy the perk there (Juggernog or Speed Cola, it alternates) if you can, then stand on the teleporter.
2. **Receiving Bay**: grab the P.E.S. right in front of you. Buy the 750 door.
3. Take **Tunnel 6** (cheaper) to the Power Room and turn on the power.
4. Open the Labs and grab the **Hacker**. Hack excavator panels when the warning plays.
5. Go back to Area 51 from the teleporter Outside to **Pack-a-Punch**.

| Perk | Where |
|---|---|
| Juggernog or Speed Cola | Area 51 |
| Quick Revive | Receiving Bay |
| Stamin-Up | Tunnel 11 |
| Double Tap | Labs, 1st floor |
| Deadshot Daiquiri | Labs, 3rd floor |
| Mule Kick | Outside, by the teleporter |
| Widow's Wine | Bio-Dome |

steps.title: Survive Area 51
steps.text: Power is always on here. Pack-a-Punch and one perk are here. No rounds: zombies and dogs get tougher the longer you stay.

steps.title: Teleport to the Moon
steps.text: It only goes when every living player stands on it.

steps.title: Put on a P.E.S.
steps.where: Locker right in front of you in the Receiving Bay
steps.text: Without it you go down after 15 seconds in vacuum (20 with Juggernog). Every airlock has a P.E.S. locker.

steps.title: Open the Receiving Bay
steps.text: Buying one door opens both.

steps.title: Go through Tunnel 6
steps.text: Cheaper and faster than Tunnel 11.

steps.title: Turn on the power
steps.where: Power Room, next to the tunnel entrances
steps.text: Oxygen and gravity come back inside buildings. Outside stays airless. Excavators can now start.

steps.title: Find the Hacker
steps.text: One of six spots.
options: Bookshelf left of the entrance from the Power Room
Bookshelf left of the bottom of the stairs to the 2nd floor
Small box right of the top of those stairs, by the flag
Blue rebar on the right just before the stairs with the Bowie Knife wall buy
Green tank in the corner right of Deadshot Daiquiri
Shelf between the wall buy and the door to the Bio-Dome

steps.title: Keep it
steps.text: It shares a slot with the P.E.S. Hold it for several rounds and it pays bonus points each round. Taking a P.E.S. sends it back to a lab spot.

steps.title: Hack the right excavator panel
steps.text: When a breach warning plays you have about four minutes. Hack the panel that glows green. Omicron is on the left. Pi and Epsilon are together on the right. Each hack pays 1000.
options: Pi: would breach Tunnel 6
Omicron: would breach Tunnel 11
Epsilon: would breach the Bio-Dome

steps.title: Go Outside
steps.text: No oxygen outside: wear a P.E.S.

steps.title: Stand on the teleporter
steps.text: Every player must stand on it. It sends you back to Area 51. You can also jump onto it from the KN-44 wall buy area.

steps.title: Pack and return
steps.text: Pack-a-Punch, then use the Area 51 teleporter again. The Moon teleporter will not take you back to Area 51 until the next round.

guides.title: Session plan: what order to do things
guides.body:
A clean solo run, in order. Each line has its own step-by-step guide.

1. **Rounds 1 to 4**: turn on Generator 1, open towards Generator 3 and 2. It snows on rounds 2 to 4, so **dig for Ice Staff parts now**. Grab the shield Face Screen and Handles and the Maxis Brain as you pass.
2. **Open the Excavation Site**: pick up the gramophone inside, find the black record outside it, grab the Maxis Rotor.
3. **Generators 4 and 5**: purple record at Gen 4, yellow record at Gen 5, shield Frame near Gen 4. Build the shield.
4. **Church and Generator 6**: red record, a Fire Staff part from the Gen 6 reward box, blue record on the way back at the Tank Station.
5. **Ride the tank** for the three Lightning Staff parts.
6. **Robots** for the three Wind Staff parts.
7. **Round 8**: the Panzer drops a Fire Staff part. Shoot down the glowing plane for the last one.
8. All six generators on = Pack-a-Punch at the top of the Excavation Site.
9. Gems from the Crazy Place, build the staffs, then upgrade the one you like.

| Staff | Record | Record found near | Tunnel to the Crazy Place |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ice | Blue | Tank Station (Gen 2) | Near the Church |
| Wind | Yellow | Generator 5 | Near Generator 4 |
| Fire | Red | Church | Near spawn, on the way to Gen 3 |
| Lightning | Purple | Generator 4 | Near Generator 5 |

Note: each record sits near a **different** staff's tunnel. That is what trips people up.

guides.title: Build the Zombie Shield
guides.intro: Three parts, each with three possible spawns. Check the spots in the order listed; they are ordered along your normal route. Build at any workbench.

steps.where: Spawn side, around the Fire tunnel and Speed Cola
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: Fire tunnel: on a table to the right of the gateway
Trench room to the right of the Fire tunnel
Trench tunnel near Speed Cola, behind the crate on the way to the Workshop

steps.title: Part 2: Handles
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: Trench room on the right of the first area leading from spawn to Generator 2
End of the trenches past Generator 2 and the Workshop
On top of the Tank Station by Generator 2, near broken piping

steps.title: Part 3: Shield Frame
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: Next to Generator 4, left of the MP40 / KN-44 wall buy
In the marsh just outside Generator 4, heading to the trenches for the Church
In a giant robot footprint near the Excavation Site

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Hold the use button at a workbench. If it breaks later, take a new one for free from the same bench.

guides.title: Build the Maxis Drone
guides.intro: The drone shoots, grabs power-ups and can revive you. Also needed for the main easter egg.

steps.title: Part 1: Brain
steps.text: Always the same place: on a table next to the stairs that go up to Generator 1.

steps.title: Part 2: Frame
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: By the crossbones sign on the tank's muddy path towards Generator 4
By the crossbones sign on the tank's muddy path towards Generator 5
In the Ice tunnel near Generator 6, in front of the portal

steps.title: Part 3: Rotor
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: Near the very bottom, on a box on the scaffolding next to a lever
On top of the Excavation Site near Pack-a-Punch
Around the secret entrance of the Excavation Site

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Deploy it like equipment. It lasts about 90 seconds, then recharges at the bench.

guides.title: Gramophone and the five records
guides.intro: You need the gramophone for everything staff-related. Records are thin discs lying flat on crates, shelves and tables.

steps.title: Gramophone
steps.text: Always on the floor next to a table inside the Excavation Site once you have opened it.

steps.title: Black record (opens the lower level)
steps.text: One of three spots. Then place the gramophone on the table inside to open the stairs down.
options: Next to the Excavation Site sign
In the wheelbarrow next to Pack-a-Punch
In the trench by the debris that opens the way to the Church

steps.title: Blue record (Ice)
steps.text: On one of the shelves inside the Tank Station.

steps.title: Purple record (Lightning)
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: Inside the Wind tunnel, near the gateway
On the wagon to the left as you enter that tunnel
On the table next to the Der Wunderfizz machine

steps.title: Yellow record (Wind)
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: On the half-broken wall to the right of Stamin-Up
On the boxes near the Lightning tunnel entrance
On the table just inside the Lightning tunnel

steps.title: Red record (Fire)
steps.text: One of three spots.
options: On boxes between the tank and the staircase up (hard to see when the tank is parked there)
On the church benches opposite the basin
On boxes next to Generator 6

guides.title: Ice Staff: build
guides.intro: The parts are buried and can only be dug up **while it is snowing** (rounds 2 to 4, round 10, then random). Do this first. You need the shovel: one is in the spawn room.

steps.title: Dig part 1: starting area
steps.text: Dig every pile on both sides of the trenches until a staff part pops out.

steps.title: Dig part 2: middle of the map
steps.where: No Man's Land around the Excavation Site

steps.title: Blue record
steps.text: On a shelf inside.

steps.title: Get the blue gem from the Crazy Place
steps.text: You need the gramophone and the blue record. Place the gramophone at the Ice tunnel entrance, go through the portal, and take the gem from the pedestal glowing blue. The gem only appears if you came in through the Ice tunnel. Pick the gramophone back up on your way out.

steps.title: Build the staff
steps.text: You need the gramophone and the black record to open the lower level. Build it on the **blue** pedestal.

guides.title: Wind Staff: build
guides.intro: One part is inside the head of each of the three giant robots.

steps.title: How to get inside a robot
steps.text: As a robot walks over, look at the underside of its feet. **One foot has lights on it.** Shoot that foot so the hatch opens, then stand under it and let it step on you. You are pulled up into the head. Which foot is lit changes every pass.

steps.title: Part 1: first robot
steps.text: Grab the part on the floor of the head, then use the exit to drop back down. Each of the three robots holds one part.

steps.title: Part 2: second robot
steps.text: Same as above.

steps.title: Part 3: third robot
steps.text: Same as above.

steps.title: Yellow record
steps.text: Half-broken wall right of Stamin-Up, boxes by the Lightning tunnel entrance, or the table just inside that tunnel.

steps.title: Get the yellow gem from the Crazy Place
steps.text: You need the gramophone and the yellow record. Place the gramophone at the Wind tunnel entrance, go through the portal, and take the gem from the pedestal glowing yellow. The gem only appears if you came in through the Wind tunnel. Pick the gramophone back up on your way out.

steps.title: Build the staff
steps.text: You need the gramophone and the black record to open the lower level. Build it on the **yellow** pedestal.

guides.title: Fire Staff: build
guides.intro: No searching for these parts: you earn them.

steps.title: Part 1: Generator 6 reward box
steps.text: Capture Generator 6. The reward box next to it opens with the part.

steps.title: Part 2: shoot down the glowing plane
steps.where: Look up, near the Excavation Site
steps.text: After you open the way to the Church, a plane glowing orange circles overhead from the next round. Shoot it down. The part lands by the soul box closest to the Excavation Site, on the small walkway between two robot footprints.

steps.title: Part 3: kill the first Panzer Soldat
steps.text: It drops the part where it dies.

steps.title: Red record
steps.text: Boxes between the tank and the stairs, church benches opposite the basin, or boxes next to Generator 6.

steps.title: Get the red gem from the Crazy Place
steps.where: Fire tunnel, near spawn on the way to Generator 3
steps.text: You need the gramophone and the red record. Place the gramophone at the Fire tunnel entrance, go through the portal, and take the gem from the pedestal glowing red. The gem only appears if you came in through the Fire tunnel. Pick the gramophone back up on your way out.

steps.title: Build the staff

guides.title: Lightning Staff: build
guides.intro: All three parts are on ledges you can only reach by **jumping off the moving tank**. Call the tank at the Church or the Tank Station (500 points). Solo you will need at least two rides.

steps.title: Part 1: Church to Tank Station ride
steps.where: Right side, just before the trench to Generator 2
steps.text: Jump onto the cut-off wooden staircase on the right. Careful: the robot Thor can step here.

steps.title: Part 2: Tank Station to Church ride
steps.where: Left side, by the Excavation Site
steps.text: Jump onto the cut-off wooden scaffolding on the left that hangs off the dig site. It leads into a small hole with the part.

steps.title: Part 3: Tank Station to Church ride
steps.where: Right side, just before the Church
steps.text: Jump onto the dirt path on the right. It leads to an upper level of the Church with the part.

steps.title: Purple record
steps.text: Inside the Wind tunnel by the gateway, on the wagon left of that tunnel's entrance, or on the table next to Der Wunderfizz.

steps.title: Get the purple gem from the Crazy Place
steps.text: You need the gramophone and the purple record. Place the gramophone at the Lightning tunnel entrance, go through the portal, and take the gem from the pedestal glowing purple. The gem only appears if you came in through the Lightning tunnel. Pick the gramophone back up on your way out.

guides.title: Ice Staff: upgrade to Ull's Arrow

steps.title: Crazy Place: flip the six stone panels
steps.where: Ice section of the Crazy Place
steps.text: A blue panel on the wall shows a dot pattern. Shoot the floating stone above the portal whose symbol matches it. Six in a row; a wrong shot resets them all. A matching chart is the fastest way; tell Claude to add one here.

steps.title: Freeze and break three gravestones
steps.text: Shoot each water-dripping gravestone with the Ice Staff, then break it with a bullet weapon.
options: Right of the MP40 / KN-44 wall buy near Generator 4
Between the Excavation Site and a giant footprint, close to Generator 4
On the small hill to the right of the Tank Station's back exit (Generator 2), by the downed robot's hand

steps.title: Turn the rings blue and shoot the orb
steps.text: Go to the lower level of the Excavation Site. Pull the four levers (two on the normal walkway, two on the wooden scaffolding) until the lights on all four floating rings are **blue**. Then shoot the blue orb in the middle with the staff. It glows and shoots up.

steps.title: Charge it in the Crazy Place
steps.text: Take the Ice tunnel to the Crazy Place, put the staff in the **blue** pedestal there, and kill about 20 zombies in the Crazy Place. When Samantha speaks and the staff icon gets an outline, pick it up. If you ever lose it, it returns to its pedestal in the Excavation Site, still upgraded.

guides.title: Wind Staff: upgrade to Boreas' Fury

steps.title: Crazy Place: line up the four rings
steps.where: Wind section of the Crazy Place
steps.text: Above the portal are four rings of symbols. Shoot a ring with the Wind Staff to rotate it until each column of symbols matches the pillar it points at. The solution never changes, so a reference picture solves it; tell Claude to add one here.

steps.title: Blow three smoking stone balls towards the dig site
steps.text: Shoot each ball with the staff so its smoke drifts towards the Excavation Site.
options: At Generator 4, between the generator and the Wind tunnel
Behind Stamin-Up near Generator 5
On the tank's return path, outer No Man's Land: reach it from the Church by walking back along the tank track

steps.title: Crazy Place: fill the four cauldrons
steps.where: Fire section of the Crazy Place
steps.text: Kill about 30 zombies with the Fire Staff while they stand on the **metal grates**. They burst into black smoke that fills the cauldrons.

steps.title: Light the right four torches
steps.text: Upstairs on the far wall, four symbols are lit. Each stands for a number. In the basement, seven torches have numbers under them (the bloodstain is 4, and 4 is always one of the answers). Light the four matching torches with the staff.

steps.title: Crazy Place: play three chords
steps.where: Lightning section of the Crazy Place
steps.text:
The purple triangles on the wall are a keyboard. Use only the **bottom row** and number its seven keys 1 to 7 from left to right. Shoot these with the staff:

- **1, 3, 6**
- **3, 5, 7**
- **2, 4, 6**

steps.title: Turn seven electrical panels
steps.text: Only one panel sparks at a time. Turn its knob until it points the way shown.
options: Next to Generator 5: **down**
Church basement, by torch number 3: **right**
Church upstairs, by the repairable window: **up**
Right of the Wind tunnel entrance: **up**
Spawn room, bottom of the stairs: **left**
Tank Station, left of the back door: **down**
Behind the Excavation Site on the path to the Church: **up**
